title: Alluma reads Mondragón out of the book — 'things endure when they're built and protected by many hands'
summary: Newman retold the Basque cooperative's seventy years, from five graduates making paraffin stoves to 70,000 worker-owners, and the 2013 Fagor bankruptcy where the federation moved hundreds into other cooperatives rather than letting them go. She names the limit too: contract workers were not protected the same way.
blockquote: Mondragón is an example for Alluma that things endure when they're built and protected by many hands, interdependent and collaborating together.
